segments.name: Asia-Pacific, Middle East and Africa (APMEA)

revenueModel.text: Retailers and distributors pay for tobacco and nicotine products, with revenue recognised when control of the goods transfers to a customer.
revenueModel.evidence: For the vast majority of the Group's sales, revenue is recognised when control of the goods is transferred to a customer at a point in time
